answer_1.quote: The Chatbot Arena, a leading platform for reliable human evaluation of LLMs, has set a standard by collecting extensive human annotations.
answer_1.outputs: model responses to prompts in benchmark datasets

answer_2.quote: Benchmarks like AlpacaEval and Arena-Hard-Auto assess LLM response quality by comparing it to baseline responses from proprietary model.

answer_3.quote: We employed the judging prompt suggested in LLMBar (See Appendix A.8.2). The same judge prompt was applied consistently across both the tournament and baseline-mediated approaches.
